items.title: Schema Viewer
items.desc: Added relational ERDs, graph metagraphs, declared document JSON trees, metadata summaries, and ChironDB composite facets.

items.title: Complete access registration
items.desc: All 82 connection types and 106 product/version profiles now declare picker, runtime, connect, test-connection, and viewer contracts.

items.title: ChironDB relational profile
items.desc: Added a PostgreSQL-wire profile and internally verified DDL, DML, joins, table discovery, and column discovery.

items.title: Native metadata only
items.desc: Schema discovery does not infer structures by sampling documents, objects, values, messages, or payloads.

items.title: GitHub-backed release information
items.desc: The app periodically reads canonical release and changelog data from GitHub with a bundled offline fallback.

items.title: Gauss logo
items.desc: The Settings appearance preview now uses the Gauss logo.

items.title: Upstream v0.6.16
items.desc: Integrated the latest stable upstream release while preserving ChironDB support and profile migration compatibility.

items.title: Release hardening
items.desc: Release artifacts, agent registry, JDBC plugin, and checksum manifest now derive their version from the release tag.

items.title: Chiron Horizon
items.desc: Chiron Horizon branding, native ChironDB connections and preserved profile migration.

items.title: Native ChironQL assistant
items.desc: Parser-validated reads, human-approved writes, encrypted credentials and local result privacy.

items.title: ChironQL scripts
items.desc: Sequential statement results, per-write review, Run-local USE context and line-comment shortcuts.

items.title: Version numbering starts at 0.1.0
items.desc: First public release on the Chiron Horizon 0.1.x line.
